hook.text: A user request touches 12 services. It's slow. Which service is the bottleneck? Without observability, you're blind.

buildup.text: Observability has three pillars: metrics (numbers), logs (events), and traces (request paths across services).

discovery.text: Distributed tracing assigns a unique trace ID to each request, following it through every service it touches.

twist.text: Microservices without observability are a black box. Debugging is guesswork. Most outages last longer than necessary.

climax.text: Observability is not optional in microservices. It's the cost of admission for distributed architecture.

punchline.text: Metrics, logs, and traces — see what's happening everywhere.

quiz.question: What are the three pillars of observability?
